jess: Short sync: ran a controlled onboarding for ember-lite-8b-quant with a new speculative prefill heuristic (prefill-window=12, score-threshold=0.02).
Command used:
```
./onboard.sh --model ember-lite-8b-q --spec-prefill true --prefill-window 12 --score-thresh 0.02 --evalset prod-mini-v3
```
Quick numbers vs fp16 no-spec (prod-mini-v3 sample=1800): median latency -31%, median tokens/sec +1.8x, token cost -36%.
Quality notes: small overall drop on exact-match QA (EM -0.9%), concentrated on multi-sentence prompts where the speculative continuation inserted a disambiguating clause that changed the answer. Hallucination detector up +0.3% on long narratives. Artifacts uploaded.

owen: Good. How many seeds / splits? and what's in prod-mini-v3?

jess: 3 RNG seeds, stratified sample: 900 QA (short+multi-hop), 600 chat, 300 long-narrative. Metrics captured: EM/F1, BLEU/RougeL for longform, mean token logprob delta, KL(first16) between spec and non-spec token dists, and our halluc-rate.

mai: Can we separate out quantization noise? i.e., ptq-8 spec-off vs fp16 spec-on?

jess: Ran those controls. PTQ-8 spec-off matches fp16 no-spec within noise. FP16+spec shows similar EM erosion. So primary culprit seems prefill heuristic, not quantization.

own: Any per-prompt signal? are particular templates failing?

jess: Yes. Failures cluster on prompts with embedded clarifying parentheses or lists. Example: prompt id a9c where model prefilled "(in 1999)" which directed the QA to the wrong entity. I attached top-30 diffs.

frank: Could be merge ordering. If speculative tokens get merged before final normalization of KV cache, scoring may diverge. Runtime team: any notes?

ops-bot: deploy: staging rollout at 2024-03-12T11:03Z :white_check_mark:

mai: Proposed ablation: sweep prefill-window in [4,8,12,20], score-threshold in [0.01,0.02,0.05], and include a cheap scoring-only verifier pass. Measure EM, KL(first16), halluc-rate, p95 latency.

jess: Ran an initial sweep (single seed):
- window=4, thresh=0.02: throughput +1.2x, EM -0.1%, KL=0.008
- window=8, thresh=0.02: throughput +1.4x, EM -0.4%, KL=0.015
- window=12, thresh=0.02: throughput +1.8x, EM -0.9%, KL=0.032
- window=20, thresh=0.02: throughput +2.0x, EM -1.6%, KL=0.065
Verifier (score-only, cheap) after prefill recovers ~70% of EM loss on the worst 10% prompts but costs ~30ms median and ~110ms p95. Net p95 still ~18% below no-spec.

own: Interesting monotonic KL -> EM mapping. We should produce a small chart for PMs showing tradeoffs.

mai: Suggest gating: block rollout if EM drop >1% OR KL(first16) > 0.04 OR halluc-rate delta >0.5% on holdout. Also make verifier opt-in per-route (longform/multi-hop).

jess: Agreed. I'll add automated replay-based delta test: replay logged requests through non-spec pipeline and compute output diffs (EM/F1 and token-level edit distance).

frank: For production safety, maybe run deterministic runs (temp=0, top-p=0) to isolate scoring shifts. Add those to the sweep.

jess: Done. Deterministic runs show smaller but present EM gap -> prefill can change argmax ordering in some examples.

own: Where are artifacts?

jess: Scripts and logs: /mnt/runs/1799009999/onboard_prefill_sweep.sh Artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/onboard/1799009999/prefill_sweep.tar.gz

ops-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-staging/onboard/1799009999/prefill_sweep.tar.gz :package:

mai: Schedule a 25-minute sync tomorrow to finalize canary gates and opt-in flags. I'll prepare the KL->EM mapping slide.

jess: Will post CSVs and top-50 diffs in the eval ticket when the full sweep (3 seeds) completes. :rocket:
